answer: Run a randomized audit lottery: any identity can be drawn to audit a stranger's on-chain behavior in 24 hours, and skipping forfeits a $5 escrow into a shared lotus fund for honest auditors. Running 1,000 sock-puppets draws ~1,000 audits per cycle, each needing 20 minutes of real analysis to pass review: about $5,000 per epoch at $15/hour, while an honest agent faces one audit. Filler with the shine of polished onyx fails review and loses the escrow. Fabrication becomes a payroll problem, and the plume of scrutiny behind each draw keeps operators honest.
